issues.description: Ingest writes valid rows to SQLite before enforcing the malformed-row threshold, so a failed ingest can still leave partial data committed.
Rows with extra pipe-delimited columns are accepted instead of rejected, allowing shifted/corrupted fields to be stored as valid data.
GPU TRES parsing sums both generic and typed GPU keys, likely double-counting when AllocTRES contains both gres/gpu and gres/gpu:<type>.
Failure reporting only recognizes FAILED, TIMEOUT, and OOM, so states such as OUT_OF_MEMORY are omitted from failure reports and rates.
Timestamps are validated but stored unnormalized, which makes SQLite string comparisons unreliable if inputs mix naive and timezone-offset ISO values.
Report commands call connect(), which creates a new empty database on typo/missing paths instead of failing loudly.
rows_to_text manually joins pipe-delimited fields without CSV escaping, so values containing pipes or newlines generate corrupt fixture/input text.
